invariants.statement: Only msg.sender equal to the immutable configured wrapper reaches the virtual callback hook.
Raffle resolves only when not in-flight, Drawing, request ID matches, exactly one word is supplied, and time is strictly before the callback deadline.
An accepted callback stores a one-based winning entry in [1,totalEntries] and changes status to NftWon or CashWon.
After the first accepted callback, duplicate callbacks are ignored because status is no longer Drawing.
Callbacks at or after the deadline are ignored, while the Drawing refund branch is eligible at the same boundary.

assumptions.statement: The immutable wrapper address identifies the intended canonical VRF wrapper.
assumptions.established_by: Deployment tooling selection plus nonzero/code-presence checks; canonical identity is established by nothing in target code.

assumptions.statement: The wrapper binds returned randomness and request IDs to the earlier paid request.
assumptions.established_by: nothing found; wrapper implementation is absent, while Raffle only checks the stored ID and one-word shape.

assumptions.statement: ABI calldata is decodable before the gateway body runs.
assumptions.established_by: Solidity external decoding; Raffle source explicitly documents the malformed-calldata path.

callees.name: Raffle.fulfillRandomWords
callees.dependency: Establishes current-request, lifecycle, word-count, and deadline acceptance; ignored paths emit without storage writes, accepted path records the terminal result.

callees.name: Raffle.callbackDeadline
callees.dependency: Derives the exclusive callback bound from drawRequestedAt and the fixed two-day timeout.

callers_and_paths.path: Dispatches to Raffle; callback is either ignored or resolves according to the downstream five-part guard.
Authentication passes but _requestInFlight forces the ignore path until the request returns, the ID is stored, and the flag is cleared.
Implementation status is Refunding, so the Raffle override emits the ignored event and returns.

writes: Accepted Raffle dispatch writes winningEntry, resolvedAt, and status (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L518-L521)

open_questions: Wrapper implementation behavior for request binding, word generation, scheduling, retry, and gas forwarding is not visible in target.
Actual deployed wrapper identity and runtime code are outside target.
Wrapper upgradeability and authority behind calls from the wrapper address are not represented by the supplied interface.
